India bearings market: estimates $6.71-9.18B by 2030-2032, CAGR 10.2-13.5% depending on source. India automotive bearing market specifically (narrower, more mature): $503.3M (2024) to $725.5M by 2033 (4.15%/yr).

market.domesticSlice: Asia-Pacific leads with ~45% global engine-bearings share, driven by vehicle production in China, India, Japan, South Korea

structureFacts: EV adoption is a long-term headwind for pure engine bearings (no combustion engine = no engine bearing demand), but final ICE-platform production waves plus a large in-operation ICE parc sustain near-term demand
Emissions-compliance-driven engine platform updates continue to create bearing redesign/requalification demand even on ICE platforms

adoptionStructure.note: Dual demand track — OEM design-in (new vehicle production, multi-year platform-life supply contracts) and aftermarket (existing ICE vehicle parc, cycle-independent) — not a fixed repurchase rate
